lines.en:
They're here, love... I mean, Diana. I mean...
We have guests! Come and greet your adoring public!
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: With no one to carry the Temple scripture's legacy, this book's secrets are locked away... forever.
lines.zh: 因为没有人继承圣殿经文的遗产，这本书的秘密如今永远的……被封存了。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: That the corrupt hearts of men will someday exploit our new found ignorance...  Its certitude is troubling. And one wonders what I must now do to protect the future.
lines.zh: 总有一天人类内心的腐败会利用我们这新出现的无知…… 这一未来的确然性令人不安。我不知道为了保护未来我现在该做些什么。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: My apologies... it's good to see you again.
lines.zh: 我很抱歉……能再见到你真的很高兴。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: They say you have decided not to take the title of Grandmistress of the Temple... but why? Who better to serve in this role?
lines.zh: 他们说你已经决定不接受圣殿女圣宗的头衔了……可为什么啊？又有谁更适合担任这个角色呢？
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: ...It is not my title to bear.  A mind and soul of great caliber and purity will come to fulfill the role... I can only do my best until then.  Did you need something of the Temple?
lines.zh: ……这不是我承担得起的尊号。 一个头脑与灵魂强大且纯净的人将履行这个角色……在那之前我只能尽力而为。 你需要圣殿的什么帮助吗？
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Diana, I just wanted to see if now'd be a good time to make my induction into the Sisterhood of Justice official!  You mentioned, back in Embor, that we should do this when we get the chance, in front of all the Temple.  I know I have much to answer for... so perhaps now I've lost the privilege...
lines.zh: 戴安娜，我只是想看看，现在是否是让我正式加入正义修女会的好时机！ 在恩博尔那时您提到过，等到有机会的时候，要在全圣殿的面前举行仪式。 我知道我有很多过错要弥补……所以也许现在我已经失去了这份殊荣……
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: And, well... I was also wondering if Barnabas and I could get married here!
lines.zh: 而且，嗯……我也在想我和巴纳巴斯能不能在这里结婚！
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: Whoa, hold up a minute!  Well now you've got me in a pickle, askin' all formally like that.
lines.zh: 哇，等一下！ 好吧，现在你让我纠结惨了，这么正儿八经地要求。
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en: Oh come on, what are you waitin' for, the right time to settle down?  Hahaha!
lines.zh: 噢拜托，你还在等什么，合适的安顿时机吗？ 哈哈哈！
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: Heh. Fair enough.
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en:
Ah, you'd just like to make it formal.  To be honest, I'd forgotten all about that. To me, your induction into the sacred order was official then and there.  But, after your decision to follow Lysander, I still want to see you mature a bit, not to fall so easily to suggestion. You must be your own person.  ... One year of satisfactory service to the Temple, then you will reach the first rank within the Sisterhood of Justice.  That's the best I can do, and I believe you have what it takes.
And in regards to a marriage ceremony, talk to Stefan about that.  Though, I suggest the groom agree voluntarily first.
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: I am ready, Diana... more than ever, to devote myself to this Temple.  I formally request another chance to become a member of the Sisterhood of Mercy.  I'll do whatever it takes.
lines.zh: 我准备好了，戴安娜……我比以往任何时候都更愿意献身于这圣殿。 我正式请求，能得到机会再次成为慈悲修女会的一员。 我会为此付出一切的。
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: And, well... I was also wondering if Barnabas and I could get married here!
lines.zh: 而且，嗯……我也在想我和巴纳巴斯能不能在这里结婚！
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: Whoa, hold up a minute!  Well now you've got me in a pickle, askin' all formally like that.
lines.zh: 哇，等一下！ 好吧，现在你让我纠结惨了，这么正儿八经地要求。
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en: Oh come on, what are you waitin' for, the right time to settle down?  Hahaha!
lines.zh: 噢拜托，你还在等什么，合适的安顿时机吗？ 哈哈哈！
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: Heh. Fair enough.
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en:
...Given the circumstances, perhaps another chance is warranted.  I do not blame you for what you must feel is a betrayal. You could not ignore your instincts.  But this will be the second Temple induction chance for you, which is highly unusual...  One year of satisfactory service, then you will be granted the first rank within the Sisterhood of Mercy.  That's the best I can do, and I believe you have what it takes.
And in regards to a marriage ceremony, talk to Stefan about that.  Though, I suggest the groom agree voluntarily first.
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Hey, not bad, all things considered! Whaddya say?
lines.zh: 嘿，总的来说还不错啊！你觉得呢？
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: ...  Thank you so much. You won't regret this, I swear!
lines.zh: …… 太感谢了。你不会后悔的，我发誓！
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: Protagonist...  We go into the unknown.  With the dark god slain, the people of Tahnra again have the power to bring about great change, for both good and evil.  I do not know what lies ahead for you. But if you need me, I'll be there.
lines.zh: Protagonist…… 我们进入了未知的世界。 随着黑暗之神的终结，塔恩拉的人们再次拥有了做出巨大变革的力量，无论是为了行善还是做恶。 我不知道你将会面对什么。但如果你需要我，我定当效劳。
lines.name: 戴安娜
